I am confused about paying zakat on these lands.I would like to know if you purchase land for the purpose of building a house in the distant future may be on the same or some other property by selling this one do you have to pay zakat on it? Also is there a one year grace period before zakat becomes due ? please advise. 2972 views Q. I am working in the Netherlands and would like to request you to kindly guide me for following question. I along with some of family members would like to start a student welfare fund from Zakat money. Where we are planning to collect our zakat money in a separate account and give to different deserving students (orphans etc.) for higher studies. But this will be a soft loan without any interest, service charges or time limitations. When candidate will start job, he has to return with 10 % of his salary. This returning money will be used for further students. In this case once money is gone from our pocket as for zakat, it will never come back but will be in circle for deserving students. Please let me know the Islamic value of above mentioned process. Is it allowed to do like this or not? Thank you very much in advance for your kind guidance. 1662 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 60666 Country: India Title: zakat Question: We borrowed money from our relatives and bank loan (gold) for house. We do not have saving money only we some gold which we taken load from bank. So my question is we to give zakah or not? Answer ID: 60666 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1328/1428/L=12/1436) Zakah is not wajib on borrowed items. So it is not wajib for you to pay the zakah of those jewelry. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
